title: MCP tool
author: Atlas core
description: Call one tool of a Model Context Protocol server (ADR-draft-mcp-worker). A model names the Worker — the server —, the tool and one object of the tool's arguments; where the server is and the credential it asks for live in the Worker and the vault and reach only the worker. A Worker lists the tools a process may call on it, each with what a second delivery does; a tool that is not listed is not called. Placed in an agent-driven ad-hoc subprocess the task is one of the agent's tools, described by the modeller's own documentation and never by the server's. A tool that ran and reported a failure is the BPMN error MCP_TOOL_ERROR where the process catches it.

properties.label: Worker
properties.description: Name of the configured MCP Worker (Console → Workers): the server whose tool the task calls, never a credential.

properties.label: Tool
properties.description: The tool to call, by the name the server lists it under. The Worker must permit it.

properties.label: Arguments
properties.description: A JSON object of the tool's arguments. A string value starting with = is a FEEL expression over the variables the task sees.

properties.label: Result variable
properties.description: The process variable the tool's result is written into: its structured result when it gives one, its text otherwise.
